title: Eulerian and Bipartite Partial Duals of Hypermaps
summary: We study hyperedge partial duals of finite hypermaps in a purely combinatorial framework, without assuming orientability. A hypermap is represented by three fixed-point-free involutions $(τ_0,τ_1,τ_2)$ on its flag set. We first give an explicit construction of the medial map from this model: $02$-orbits become the medial vertex discs, while $τ_1$-transpositions become the medial bands; a local orientation system and its twist data then provide a signed rotation description of the medial map.
